lead.t: Spondyloarthritis (SpA) is a group of inter‑related inflammatory rheumatic diseases that primarily affect the axial skeleton (sacroiliac joints and spine) and may involve peripheral joints, entheses, skin, eyes and the gastrointestinal tract.
